## Bundled QR code generation

`qrcode/` comes from the `QRCode` vendor directory bundled in the `qrcode-terminal` npm package (version 0.12.0). The original QRCode for JavaScript was authored by Kazuhiko Arase (2009), and is MIT licensed. The npm package `qrcode-terminal` by Gord Tanner and contributors is distributed under Apache License 2.0; its license is included in `APACHE-2.0.txt`. The code has been copied intact (apart from package placement); `src/qr.js` is original code which renders the resulting matrix as an SVG.

See the copyright headers in the third-party source files. QR Code is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
